obligations.feature: Adding an already-added repository again (Clone or Open project) makes a new project: no duplicate check, a new repos row, and Clone picks a unique folder (name-v1, name-v2)
obligations.gap: Conductor 0.87.6 never compares Clone or Open project against added repos (REA, decoded index chunk, createRepo; repos has no unique constraint in conductor.schema.sql), so a second add becomes its own project. The rebuild does the opposite in every UI path: Open project and the Add-repository menu refuse with REPO_EXISTS (findExistingRepo, App.tsx and AddRepositoryMenu.tsx), and the Home Clone dialog result is dropped by the store. Only clone_repository matches: it picks a unique folder name and is tested (clone_repository_streams_progress_and_picks_a_unique_name). Fix in progress from Home builder c709d09b.
obligations.done_when: the existing backend logic is reached from the UI (no localStorage-only path) and behaves as the cited evidence describes

The GitHub repo cannot be skipped, and no real first workspace is created (App.tsx onCreated adds an in-memory placeholder under a client-side repo id).
obligations.done_when: the gap in `why` is closed and the feature matches the cited evidence end to end
